subject: Archaeology
title: Howard Carter Opens Tutankhamun's Tomb
description: One-minute skill: Howard Carter Opens Tutankhamun's Tomb.

hook.text: After six years of fruitless digging, Howard Carter had one season left before his funding ran out.

buildup.text: On November 4, 1922, a water boy tripped over a stone step in the Valley of the Kings.

discovery.text: Carter peered through a hole in the sealed door and saw gold glinting everywhere by candlelight.

twist.text: Newspapers invented a 'curse of the pharaoh' when Lord Carnarvon died weeks after the opening.

climax.text: The tomb contained over 5,000 artifacts, including the iconic solid gold death mask.

punchline.text: The most famous tomb in history was found by accident with days to spare.

quiz.question: What led to the discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb?
options: Carter followed a map found in another pharaoh's tomb
A water boy tripped over a stone step leading to the entrance
Satellite imaging revealed a hidden chamber underground

details.summary: In November 1922, Howard Carter discovered the virtually intact tomb of the boy pharaoh Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings. The tomb contained over 5,000 artifacts including the iconic gold death mask, making it the most spectacular Egyptian tomb discovery ever.
details.whyItMatters: Tutankhamun's tomb ignited global Egyptomania and remains the benchmark against which all archaeological discoveries are measured. Its intact state provided unprecedented insight into pharaonic burial practices and material culture.
takeaways: Howard Carter found the intact tomb in November 1922
Over 5,000 artifacts survived including the gold death mask
It remains the most complete pharaonic burial ever discovered

faq.question: Why was Tutankhamun's tomb so well preserved?
faq.answer: The tomb entrance was buried beneath debris from a later tomb's construction, hiding it from ancient robbers. Although entered briefly by thieves in antiquity, the tomb was resealed and its location forgotten for over 3,000 years until Carter's systematic search uncovered it.

faq.question: How long did it take to clear Tutankhamun's tomb?
faq.answer: Carter spent nearly a decade cataloging and removing artifacts — the clearance lasted from 1922 to 1930. Each object was photographed, drawn, conserved, and carefully transported. The meticulous approach set new standards for archaeological recording.
